chunks: May Allah, Exalted is He, support him. It is not permissible that anything be cut from his hair nor from his nails; and if anything from that falls off, it should be placed with him in his shrouds.

key_terms.أَظْفَارِهِ: his nails; the nails of the deceased person
key_terms.أَكْفَانِهِ: his shrouds; the burial cloths of the deceased
key_terms.سَقَطَ: fell off; came off without deliberate cutting
key_terms.شَعْرِهِ: his hair; the hair of the deceased person
key_terms.لَا يَجُوزُ: it is not permissible; a clear legal prohibition
key_terms.يُقَصَّ: to be cut; referring here to trimming or removing

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to cut the hair or nails of a deceased person before burial?
ai.summary: This passage gives a legal ruling concerning the deceased, stating that nothing should be cut from the hair or nails. If any part of them falls off, it should be placed within the shrouds of the deceased, reflecting care and respect in funerary preparation.
